proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator-level config semantics: new nChannelsPerNetPeer/graphUsageMode/maxP2pPeers parsing, validation, env overrides, and cross-rank agreement in init/comm state. device-topology is additionally needed because src/graph/paths.cc changes the actual P2P channel-per-peer/topology-derived channel computation and max-peer channel tuning logic. enqueue is additionally needed because runtime execution behavior changes in strong stream graph-mixing handling and P2P plan batching/scheduling paths (including budget/error behavior) in enqueue/strongstream code.
